title: Land cover of the creek catchment (land_cover_classes 1.0.0)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe land_cover_classes 1.0.0 for Calaveras Creek catchment: the ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 class of each of the 2573395 10 m cells of the catchment, with a table of cells, area and share per class and per configured group. A 2021 context map, not pasture types.

ESA WorldCover 2021 is a single 2021 map classified from satellite data at 10 m: its classes can differ from the ground, and the class of one cell is not a field observation. Tree cover on the valley floor may include orchards; cropland is a small share of the catchment in this map (the class 'cropland or built-up' is excluded from the sampling strata, never read as low vegetation). No class is a pasture, agdal or management unit. Areas are cell counts times 100 m2 in EPSG:32629, not geodesic areas, and cells on the polygon's boundary are counted where their centre lies inside it. The catchment is a hydrological analysis extent, not a pasture, agdal or management boundary.

siterra:dataset.resolution_note: WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, nearest neighbour onto the 10 m EPSG:32610 analysis grid

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32610

operation_order: Layer: the WorldCover 2021 v200 class code of each 10 m analysis cell (nearest neighbour from the 10 m product, EPSG:32629), 0 outside the frozen polygon; uint8 cloud-optimised GeoTIFF, DEFLATE, nodata 0, on the analysis grid of the strata bundle

Class table: for each class present inside the polygon, its code, name, number of 10 m cells, area in km2 (cells times 100 m2 in EPSG:32629) and share of the cells inside the polygon, to 4 decimals; the table lists the configured classes (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80) and any other class found, which stops the build
Groups: the configured land cover groups with their classes and combined share, as in the place configuration

Acceptance checks, all stored with the bundle: the class counts sum to the number of 10 m cells inside the polygon (the analysis grid mask); every cell inside the polygon has a class (no 0 inside); no class outside the configured list; cropland plus built-up cells equal the excluded layer of the strata raster; the layer read back from the stored file equals the placed WorldCover grid cell for cell; two runs give identical files apart from the computed time

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: Recomputed from the stored layer. The class counts sum to 2573395 against 2573395 10 m cells inside the polygon; 0 inside cells have class 0; classes outside the configured list: none; cropland plus built-up cells 4049 against 4049 in the excluded layer of the strata raster; 0 cells of the stored file differ from the placed WorldCover grid. The whole build run twice in one process gives an identical file: True.

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Class codes are the ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 legend values (10 tree cover, 20 shrubland, 30 grassland, 40 cropland, 50 built-up, 60 bare or sparse vegetation, 80 permanent water bodies); areas are km2 from 10 m cells of 100 m2 in EPSG:32610; shares are fractions of the cells inside the polygon.

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: Nodata is 0 and means outside the polygon; no WorldCover class has code 0 and 0 cells inside the polygon carry it.

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present
siterra:checks.detail: The Copernicus DEM notices (Article 6(b) and 6(c)) and the liability statement and the ESA WorldCover citation (CC BY 4.0) are in siterra:attribution.

siterra:checks.name: visual_inspection_sample
siterra:checks.detail: Rendered the stored classes in the WorldCover legend colours (shown at a quarter of the 10 m size) and looked at the whole catchment on 2026-10-30 (first build, geometry revision 1): grassland and tree cover share almost all of it with tree cover on gullies and shaded slopes and grassland on open slopes, the large reservoir sits at the downstream end and a few small ponds and scattered cropland or built-up cells lie in the south-east, and the dark outside matches the frozen polygon. The layer was then rebuilt on geometry revision 2 (15 more boundary cells) and its stored classes differ from the inspected build in only the boundary cells (the render differs in 8 of 565,378 display pixels). Tree cover here may include oak woodland and savanna; the map was not compared with imagery or field observations.
